stories.title: Ursula von der Leyen propose au Canada de devenir le « premier membre associé » de l’Union européenne

en.title: Ursula von der Leyen proposes Canada become the "first associated member" of the European Union
en.summary: The European Commission president has proposed a new status for Canada as an associated member of the EU. This status currently has no legal basis and raises questions on both sides of the Atlantic.

stories.title: Présidentielle en France : Philippe Brun suspendu pour par le Parti socialiste avant la primaire

en.title: French presidential race: Philippe Brun suspended by Socialist Party before primary
en.summary: The Socialist Party suspended deputy Philippe Brun and excluded him from the social-democrat primary over violence accusations. Brun stated he is unaware of the specific charges against him.

stories.title: EN DIRECT – Ursula von der Leyen propose au Canada de devenir «membre associé» de l’UE, l’Allemagne s’oppose au terme

en.title: LIVE - Ursula von der Leyen proposes Canada become "associated member" of EU, Germany opposes the term
en.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney addressed the European Parliament as guest of honor during the Commission president's policy speech, receiving a standing ovation from lawmakers.

stories.title: Le député Philippe Brun exclu de la primaire du PS après des accusations de "violence", l'intéressé évoque sa "stupeur"

en.title: Deputy Philippe Brun excluded from Socialist Party primary after "violence" accusations, says he is bewildered
en.summary: The Eure deputy was suspended provisionally from the Socialist Party and its parliamentary group following violence allegations. Brun expressed shock over his exclusion from the primary.

stories.title: La messe du pape à Paris cumule déjà plus de 600 000 inscriptions, le périmètre d'accès élargi

en.title: Pope's Mass in Paris already has over 600,000 registrations, access perimeter expanded
en.summary: The Pope's Mass at Place de la Concorde in Paris has attracted more than 600,000 registrations. The Paris archbishop announced the registration platform will close on Wednesday at 6 p.m.

stories.title: Primaire de la gauche : cinq candidats en lice, Philippe Brun exclu

en.title: Left-wing primary: five candidates running, Philippe Brun excluded
en.summary: Five candidates are competing in the left-wing primary: Raphaël Glucksmann, Ségolène Royal, Olivier Faure, Jérôme Guedj, and Emmanuel Maurel. Deputy Philippe Brun was suspended from the Socialist Party and excluded from the race due to domestic violence allegations.

stories.title: La France a enregistré près de 8 000 morts en excès depuis la fin du mois de mai et les canicules successives, selon un bilan provisoire

en.title: France recorded nearly 8,000 excess deaths since end of May due to successive heat waves, according to provisional assessment
en.summary: France has experienced approximately 8,000 excess deaths since late May linked to consecutive heat waves. The final toll is expected to increase as data collection continues and the entire summer period is not yet included.

stories.title: Canicules : la France a enregistré près de 8000 morts en excès depuis fin mai, selon un bilan provisoire

en.title: Heat waves: France recorded nearly 8,000 excess deaths since end of May, according to provisional assessment
en.summary: France has experienced approximately 8,000 excess deaths since late May during heat wave periods. The final count will likely increase as data collection is ongoing and the full summer period through mid-September remains to be analyzed.

stories.title: Canicules en France : au moins 817 morts en excès du 27 juillet au 20 août, près de 8 000 depuis fin mai, selon un bilan provisoire

en.title: Heat waves in France: at least 817 excess deaths from July 27 to August 20, nearly 8,000 since late May, according to provisional figures
en.summary: France recorded at least 817 excess deaths during the third heat wave of summer, with nearly 8,000 excess deaths since late May. The toll is expected to increase as data collection continues, with those over 75 most affected.

stories.title: Ursula von der Leyen propose que l'Union européenne interdise les réseaux sociaux aux enfants de moins de 13 ans

en.title: Ursula von der Leyen proposes that the European Union ban social networks for children under 13 years old
en.summary: Von der Leyen proposed restricting social media access for children under 13 and limiting teenagers aged 13-15 to parent-controlled accounts with restricted features and usage time limits.

stories.title: Suspendu du PS, Philippe Brun écarté de la primaire à gauche en raison d’«accusations de violence»

en.title: Suspended from PS, Philippe Brun excluded from left-wing primary due to 'accusations of violence'
en.summary: Socialist deputy Philippe Brun was removed from the left-wing primary race following accusations of violence, despite having already submitted his endorsements, and is not among the five official candidates.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : Philippe Brun, suspendu du PS à titre conservatoire, ne participera pas à la primaire à gauche

en.title: 2027 Presidential election: Philippe Brun, suspended from PS provisionally, will not participate in left-wing primary
en.summary: The deputy for Eure has been provisionally suspended from the Socialist Party following an investigation into allegations made by a former collaborator. He denies knowledge of the reported incidents.

stories.title: Avec son algorithme, OùSoigner veut accélérer l’installation des médecins dans les déserts médicaux

en.title: With its algorithm, OùSoigner wants to accelerate doctor placements in medical deserts
en.summary: OùSoigner is a collaborative platform using an algorithm to match physicians seeking to establish practices with underserved communities lacking medical professionals.

stories.title: Avec 61 milliards d’euros de dividendes, la France prend la tête en Europe

en.title: With 61 billion euros in dividends, France takes the lead in Europe
en.summary: Major French listed companies distributed 61 billion euros in dividends to shareholders, placing France first in Europe and second globally after the United States.

stories.title: OPINION. « Immigration : pourquoi la France ne peut plus raisonner seule », par Mickaël Haïk, avocat aux barreaux de Paris et du Québec

en.title: OPINION. "Immigration: why France can no longer reason alone", by Mickaël Haïk, lawyer at the Paris and Quebec bars
en.summary: A migration law specialist argues that European migration policies, which have continental consequences, remain primarily decided at the national level rather than collectively.

stories.title: « Doubler les performances de ses prédécesseurs » : focus sur les Sentinel 3 avec Yvan Baillion

en.title: "Doubling the performance of its predecessors": focus on Sentinel 3 with Yvan Baillion
en.summary: The Sentinel 3C satellite successfully launched on September 15 aboard Vega-C and joined the European Copernicus program, with plans already underway for successor missions.

stories.title: Le prix du gasoil peut-il vraiment atteindre 3 euros le litre ?

en.title: Can the price of diesel really reach 3 euros per liter?
en.summary: Fuel prices in France have risen continuously since the start of the Iran war and are approaching 3 euros per liter, prompting questions about whether this level is realistic.
